description: Add an empty load case — a named bucket of UNFACTORED loads of one origin (dead, snow, wind, imposed). Put loads in it with add_load, then combine cases with partial factors using add_load_combination. A load case on its own never reaches a code check: checks envelope over COMBINATIONS only. Returns the model plus the new load_case_id. Free.

model_ref.description: Handle from stash_model, used INSTEAD of `model`. Avoids sending the whole document on every step; the tool returns the same handle back.

name.description: Name, e.g. "G - Permanent", "S - Snow", "W - Wind (+X)". results.loadcases is keyed by this, so it must be unique.

name: add_load_case
title: Add a load case
